11915-the-adventures-of-mr-mocker.creator: Thornton W. Burgess
11915-the-adventures-of-mr-mocker.description: A book by Thornton W. Burgess. Winsome Bluebird goes just a little way ahead of her, for Winsome is the herald of Mistress Spring. Then comes Honker the Goose, and all the world hearing his voice from way, way, up in the blue, blue sky knows that truly Mistress Spring is on her way. And with her come Little Friend the Song Sparrow, and Cheerful Robin and Mr.

6424-a-modern-utopia.title: A Modern Utopia
6424-a-modern-utopia.creator: Unknown
6424-a-modern-utopia.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. neral picture of a Utopia that has grown up in my mind during the course of these speculations as a state of affairs at once possible and more desirable than the world in which I live. But this book has brought me back to imaginative writing again.

arxiv-2209-13925.title: DeViT: Deformed Vision Transformers in Video Inpainting Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 10–14, 2022; Lisboa, Portugal Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’22), Octobe
arxiv-2209-13925.creator: Jiayin Cai, Changlin Li, Xin Tao, Chun Yuan, Yu-Wing Tai
arxiv-2209-13925.description: Abstract . This paper proposes a novel video inpainting method. We make three main contributions: First, we extended previous Transformers with patch alignment by introducing Deformed Patch-based Homography (DePtH), which improves patch-level feature alignments without additional supervision and benefits challenging scenes with various deformation.

arxiv-2304-02303.title: Oscillations in three-reaction quadratic mass-action systems
arxiv-2304-02303.creator: Murad Banaji, Balázs Boros, Josef Hofbauer
arxiv-2304-02303.description: Abstract It is known that rank-two bimolecular mass-action systems do not admit limit cycles. With a view to understanding which small mass-action systems admit oscillation, in this paper we study rank-two networks with bimolecular source complexes but allow target complexes with higher molecularities.

arxiv-2309-08043.title: On Prediction Feature Assignment in the Heckman Selection Model
arxiv-2309-08043.creator: Huy Mai, Xintao Wu
arxiv-2309-08043.description: Abstract Under missing-not-at-random (MNAR) sample selection bias, the performance of a prediction model is often degraded. This paper focuses on one classic instance of MNAR sample selection bias where a subset of samples have non-randomly missing outcomes. The Heckman selection model and its variants have commonly been used to handle this type of sample selection bias.

arxiv-2402-01453.title: The Queen of England is not England’s Queen: On the Lack of Factual Coherency in PLMs
arxiv-2402-01453.creator: Paul Youssef Jörg Schlötterer Christin Seifert
arxiv-2402-01453.description: Abstract Factual knowledge encoded in Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) enriches their representations and justifies their use as knowledge bases. Previous work has focused on probing PLMs for factual knowledge by measuring how often they can correctly predict an object entity given a subject and a relation, and improving fact retrieval by optimizing the prompts used for querying PLMs.

arxiv-2403-09669.title: STREAM: Spatio-TempoRal Evaluation and Analysis Metric for Video Generative Models
arxiv-2403-09669.creator: Pum Jun Kim, Seojun Kim, Jaejun Yoo
arxiv-2403-09669.description: Abstract Image generative models have made significant progress in generating realistic and diverse images, supported by comprehensive guidance from various evaluation metrics. However, current video generative models struggle to generate even short video clips, with limited tools that provide insights for improvements.

arxiv-2405-01825.title: Improving Concept Alignment in Vision-Language Concept Bottleneck Models
arxiv-2405-01825.creator: Nithish Muthuchamy Selvaraj, Xiaobao Guo, Adams Wai-Kin Kong, Alex Kot
arxiv-2405-01825.description: Abstract Concept Bottleneck Models (CBM) map images to human-interpretable concepts before making class predictions. Recent approaches automate CBM construction by prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate text concepts and employing Vision Language Models (VLMs) to score these concepts for CBM training.

arxiv-2407-05889.title: Dirac’s theorem for graphs of bounded bandwidth Thanks: A. Espuny Díaz has been funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) through project no. 513704762. O. Parcyzk has been funded by the DFG under Germany’s Excellence Strategy - The Berlin Mathematics Research C
arxiv-2407-05889.creator: Alberto Espuny Díaz, Pranshu Gupta, Domenico Mergoni Cecchelli, Olaf Parczyk, Amedeo Sgueglia
arxiv-2407-05889.description: Abstract . We provide an optimal sufficient condition, relating minimum degree and bandwidth, for a graph to contain a spanning subdivision of the complete bipartite graph K 2 , ℓ K_{2,\ell} . This includes the containment of Hamilton paths and cycles, and has applications in the random geometric graph model. Our proof provides a greedy algorithm for constructing such structures.

arxiv-2501-02652.title: A View of the Certainty-Equivalence Method for PAC RL as an Application of the Trajectory Tree Method
arxiv-2501-02652.creator: Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan, Sheel Shah, Santhosh Kumar Guguloth
arxiv-2501-02652.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) enables an agent interacting with an unknown MDP M M to optimise its behaviour by observing transitions sampled from M M . A natural entity that emerges in the agent’s reasoning is M ^ \widehat{M} , the maximum likelihood estimate of M M based on the observed transitions.

arxiv-2508-18535.title: Tangling and Untangling Trees on Point-sets
arxiv-2508-18535.creator: Giuseppe Di Battista, Giuseppe Liotta, Maurizio Patrignani, Antonios Symvonis, Ioannis G. Tollis
arxiv-2508-18535.description: Abstract We study a question that lies at the intersection of classical research subjects in Topological Graph Theory and Graph Drawing: Computing a drawing of a graph with a prescribed number of crossings on a given set S S of points, while ensuring that its curve complexity (i.e., maximum number of bends per edge) is bounded by a constant.

arxiv-2509-00953.title: Performance Improvement of Deorbitalized Exchange-Correlation Functionals
arxiv-2509-00953.creator: H. Francisco, B. Thapa, S.B. Trickey, A.C. Cancio
arxiv-2509-00953.description: Abstract Deorbitalization of a conventional meta-generalized-gradient exchange-correlation approximation replaces its dependence upon the Kohn-Sham kinetic energy density with a dependence on the density gradient and Laplacian. In principle, that simplification should provide improved computational performance relative to the original meta-GGA form because of the shift from an orbital-dependent generalized Kohn-Sham potential to a true KS local potential.

arxiv-2510-12912.title: Enabling Full Duplex ISAC Leveraging Waveform Domain Separability The authors are with the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul, 34810, Turkey (e-mail: abdelali.arous@std.medipol.edu.tr; hamza.haif@std.medipol.edu.tr; huseyinarslan@medipol.edu.t
arxiv-2510-12912.creator: Abdelali Arous, , Hamza Haif, , and Hüseyin Arslan
arxiv-2510-12912.description: Abstract Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in monostatic in-band full-duplex (IBFD) systems encounters significant challenges due to self-interference (SI) at the radar receiver during concurrent communication and radar operations. This paper proposes a novel waveform-domain self-interference cancellation (SIC) technique that leverages the unique properties of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) signals.

arxiv-2510-24629.title: Approximate fibrations in higher topos theory
arxiv-2510-24629.creator: Christian Kremer, Marco Volpe
arxiv-2510-24629.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Christian Kremer, Marco Volpe. The goal of this paper is to put the theory of approximate fibrations into the framework of higher topos theory. We define the notion of an approximate fibration for a general geometric morphism of ∞ \infty -topoi, give several characterizations in terms of shape theory and compare it to the original definition for maps of topological spaces of Coram and Duvall.

plos-pone-0002821.title: Quantitative Image Analysis Reveals Distinct Structural Transitions during Aging in Caenorhabditis elegans Tissues
plos-pone-0002821.creator: Josiah Johnston, Wendy B. Iser, David K. Chow et al.
plos-pone-0002821.description: PLOS ONE research article. Aging is associated with functional and structural declines in many body systems, even in the absence of underlying disease. In particular, skeletal muscles experience severe declines during aging, a phenomenon termed sarcopenia. Despite the high incidence and severity of sarcope

pmc-11436148.title: Countermovement Jump Peak Power Changes with Age in Masters Weightlifters
pmc-11436148.creator: Bryan L. Riemann, Matthew Johnson, Matthew K. Helms, Andrew Hatchett, Joseph D. Vondrasek, Cullun Q. Watts, Marianne Huebner
pmc-11436148.description: Aging is associated with decreased muscle strength and power. Power is particularly important for maintaining the independence of older adults when performing activities of daily living. The countermovement jump has been identified as a reliable and safe method to assess lower extremity power across the lifespan.

pmc-11440307.title: Genetic dysregulation of EP300 in cancers in light of cancer epigenome control – targeting of p300-proficient and -deficient cancers
pmc-11440307.creator: Karolina Gronkowska, Agnieszka Robaszkiewicz
pmc-11440307.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Some cancer types including bladder, cervical, and uterine cancers are characterized by frequent mutations in EP300 that encode histone acetyltransferase p300. This enzyme can act both as a tumor suppressor and oncogene. In this review, we describe the role of p300 in cancer initiation and progression regarding EP300 aberrations that have been identified in TGCA Pan-Cancer Atlas studies and we also discuss possible anticancer strategies that target EP300 mutated cancers.

pmc-11512400.title: Comparison of Dual Monoclonal Antibody Therapies for COVID-19 Evolution: A Multicentric Retrospective Study †
pmc-11512400.creator: Karen Zafilaza, Jonathan Bellet, Aurélie Truffot, Vincent Foulongne, Manuela Mireille Onambele, Maud Salmona, Camille Vellas, Claire Périllaud-Dubois, Audrey Mirand, Elisabeth André-Garnier, Enagnon Kazali Alidjinou, Ségolène Brichler, Honorine Fenaux, Magali Bouvier-Alias, Cédric Hartard, Céline Do
pmc-11512400.description: Background: Neutralizing antibodies targeting the SARS-CoV-2 Spike protein reduce COVID-19-related risk of hospitalization, particularly in high-risk individuals. The COCOPREV-R study aimed to evaluate and compare clinical outcomes in high-risk SARS-CoV-2 patients treated with dual monoclonal antibody therapies and to identify associated virological factors.

pmc-11689218.title: INEQUALITIES IN OLDER ADULTS’ LIFELONG LEARNING: HOW SOCIO-ECONOMIC STATUS SHAPES PARTICIPATION AND BENEFITS
pmc-11689218.creator: Shu Yee Chin, Jolin Chua, Nathan Widjaja, Shannon Ang, Rahul Malhotra
pmc-11689218.description: Although lifelong learning has been increasingly utilized to promote active ageing, research increasingly suggests that older adults with lower socio-economic statuses (SES) may face unique barriers to participation in these programs. Simultaneously, we know little about whether SES moderates the well-being benefits of lifelong learning programs.

pmc-12370603.title: Non-invasive Follicular Thyroid Neoplasm with Papillary-like Nuclear Features and CREB3L2::PPARγ Fusion
pmc-12370603.creator: Christopher J. Dennis, Prokopios P. Argyris, Nicole A. Cipriani
pmc-12370603.description: A 58-year-old woman presented with an asymptomatic, soft-to-palpation, mobile, right thyroid mass. Subsequent ultrasonography revealed numerous, bilateral, mildly heterogenous, cystic and solid nodules, including a hypoechoic, 1.7 × 1.0 × 1.6 cm, solid, left superior pole nodule of intermediate morphologic suspicion, meeting ATA criteria for FNA biopsy.
